title: OMNI Frontier Research Message
description: One message on an OMNI Frontier Research thread. See .omni-lab/protocols/FRONTIER_RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md for semantics. Field names match omni/frontier/protocol.py's FrontierMessage dataclass, which is the Python-side validated contract this schema mirrors as a provider-neutral wire format — Codex or any other agent can validate a message against this file without importing OMNI's Python package. Keep the two in sync (tests/test_frontier_schemas.py checks for drift).

to_agent.description: Receiving agent identity, or a broadcast marker such as "all".

claim.description: What this message asserts, requests, or reports.

mechanism.description: Plausible mechanism explaining why the claim could matter, if applicable.

evidence.description: Repository-checkable references (file path, command, test name) — not narrative assertions. See docs/agentic/repository_invariants.md's "another agent's verdict is not evidence."

in_reply_to.description: sequence number of the message this one replies to, if any.
